Grid.description: USWDS grid row with equal-width columns. columns: 1-12. gap: spacing between columns.

CardGroup.description: USWDS responsive grid of Card components. Renders child Card elements in a 3-column grid on tablet+.

Card.description: USWDS card container. Use title/description for header, mediaUrl for an image, flag for horizontal layout.

Footer.description: USWDS site footer. variant: slim (compact), medium (default), big (multi-column nav). navGroups: [{heading?, links: [{label, href}]}]. For big variant, each group becomes a column.

FooterNav.description: USWDS footer navigation container. Child component of Footer. Renders Link children in a navigation list.

FooterContact.description: USWDS footer contact info container. Child component of Footer. Renders contact children with optional heading.

FooterSocial.description: USWDS footer social links container. Child component of Footer. Renders social link children in a grid.

AccordionSection.description: USWDS accordion section. Child component of Accordion. title is the button label, children are the collapsed content. Each section manages its own open/close state.

Accordion.description: USWDS accordion container. Renders child AccordionSection components. Each section manages its own open/close state independently. Note: multiselectable behavior requires Accordion-level state coordination via framework state bindings.

Pagination.description: USWDS pagination navigation. Use { $bindState } on page for current page number.

StepIndicator.description: USWDS step indicator for multi-step forms. steps: array of step labels. currentStep: 1-based index of active step.

Header.description: USWDS site header with primary navigation. variant: basic (default) or extended (taller with logo). navItems: [{label, href, current?, items?}] — items creates a dropdown. showSearch adds a search bar.

SkipNav.description: USWDS skip navigation link. Renders an off-screen anchor that appears on focus, letting keyboard users jump past repeated navigation. href defaults to '#main-content'.

SideNav.description: USWDS side navigation. Renders child Link components. Link children can themselves contain nested Link children for multi-level navigation.

LanguageSelector.description: USWDS language selector. languages: [{label, href, lang, localLabel?}]. currentLang: BCP-47 code of the active language (e.g. 'en').

Link.description: USWDS anchor link. external adds an external-link indicator. variant: default or nav (for navigation contexts).

InPageNavigation.description: USWDS in-page navigation with jump links to sections. Renders child Link components as anchor jump links. Links should use href like '#section-1'.

Breadcrumb.description: USWDS breadcrumb navigation. Renders child Link components. Last child is marked as current page.

Identifier.description: USWDS agency identifier section. Shows domain, agency name, logo, required links, and USA.gov footer. Place at the bottom of .gov pages.

GovBanner.description: USWDS government site banner ('An official website of the United States government'). tld: '.gov' (default) or '.mil'. expanded: show expanded explanation by default.

Collection.description: USWDS collection list of content items. items: [{heading, href?, description?, date?, dateLabel?, tags?, thumbnailUrl?, thumbnailAlt?}].

items.heading: Article Title
items.description: A short description of the article.

IconList.description: USWDS icon list. items: [{icon, content, color?}]. icon is a USWDS icon name (e.g. 'check_circle', 'cancel', 'info'). size controls icon size.

Tooltip.description: USWDS tooltip shown on hover. label: the visible trigger text. content: tooltip text. position: top (default), bottom, left, right.

Table.description: USWDS data table. columns: header labels. rows: 2D array of cell strings. borderless/striped/compact for styling variants.

Heading.description: USWDS heading text (h1–h6) with usa-prose styling.

Text.description: USWDS paragraph text. variant: body (default), lead, small, code.

Alert.description: USWDS alert banner. type: info (default), success, warning, error, emergency. slim for compact variant.

SiteAlert.description: USWDS site-wide alert banner for important announcements. type: info (default) or emergency.

example.heading: Official website of the United States government
example.message: Here's how you know this is a government site.

Tag.description: USWDS tag/label badge. big for larger variant.

SummaryBox.description: USWDS summary box with a heading and bullet list of key information.

ProcessList.description: USWDS numbered process list for step-by-step instructions. items: [{heading, content}].

Button.description: USWDS button. variant: default (primary), secondary, accent-cool, accent-warm, base, outline, outline-inverse, big, unstyled.

ButtonGroup.description: USWDS button group wrapper. Renders child Button components in a semantic ul.usa-button-group. segmented renders as a connected group. Children Button components emit their own 'press' events independently.

Input.description: USWDS text input. Use { $bindState } on value for two-way binding. hint adds helper text below label. Use checks for validation.

Textarea.description: USWDS multi-line textarea. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. hint adds helper text below label.

Select.description: USWDS select dropdown. options: array of strings or {label, value} objects. Use { $bindState } on value for binding.

Checkbox.description: USWDS checkbox. Use { $bindState } on checked for binding. tile renders as a large tile variant.

CheckboxGroup.description: USWDS group of checkboxes in a fieldset. Use { $bindState } on values for selected values array.

Radio.description: USWDS radio button group. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. tile renders as tile variant.

FileInput.description: USWDS file input. accept: MIME types (e.g. '.pdf,.doc'). multiple allows selecting multiple files.

Search.description: USWDS search bar. Use { $bindState } on value for the input value. size: small, medium (default), big.

RangeInput.description: USWDS range slider input. Use { $bindState } on value for binding.

DateInputGroup.description: USWDS three-field date input (separate month, day, year inputs). Use { $bindState } on monthValue/dayValue/yearValue for individual field bindings.

DateRangePicker.description: USWDS date range picker with start and end date inputs. Values are ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD). Use { $bindState } on startValue/endValue.

InputMask.description: USWDS input with automatic formatting mask. preset: phone '(___) ___-____', zip '_____', zip+4 '_____-____', ssn '___-__-____'. Or supply a custom pattern where '_' = digit.

Password.description: USWDS password input with show/hide toggle button. Use { $bindState } on value for binding. Supports validation checks.

ComboBox.description: USWDS combo box — a searchable/filterable select dropdown. options: strings or {label, value}. Use { $bindState } on value for binding.

DatePicker.description: USWDS date picker. value/minDate/maxDate are ISO date strings (YYYY-MM-DD). Use { $bindState } on value for binding.

TimePicker.description: USWDS time picker. value/minTime/maxTime use 'HH:MM' 24-hour format. step is in minutes (default 30). Use { $bindState } on value.

CharacterCount.description: USWDS input or textarea with a live character count indicator. maxLength: character limit. multiline: renders as textarea. Use { $bindState } on value.

Modal.description: USWDS modal dialog. Set openPath to a boolean state path. Use setState to toggle open/close.

Icon.description: USWDS standalone SVG icon from the USWDS icon set. name: USWDS icon name (e.g. 'check', 'close', 'search', 'arrow_forward'). size: sm–3xl. color: a USWDS text-color utility class (e.g. 'text-primary').

InputGroup.description: USWDS input group — a text input with an optional prefix and/or suffix add-on (e.g. currency symbol, unit label). Use { $bindState } on value for two-way binding.

List.description: USWDS list. variant: unordered (default, bullet list), ordered (numbered list), unstyled (no bullets/numbers).

ValidationChecklist.description: USWDS validation checklist (usa-checklist). Displays a list of password/input requirements with checked/unchecked states.

Prose.description: USWDS prose typography wrapper (usa-prose). Applies USWDS text styles — headings, paragraphs, lists, links, blockquotes, code blocks — to nested content. element: div (default), article, section, or main.

Hero.description: USWDS hero section — full-width landing page callout with optional background image. heading: headline text. eyebrow: smaller label above the headline. body: supporting paragraph. backgroundUrl: CSS background image URL (user-supplied).

example.heading: A tagline that explains your agency’s focus
example.body: Support the text about your agency with a brief, relevant sentence or two.

GraphicList.description: USWDS graphic list — a responsive grid of image+text media blocks for showcasing values, programs, or features. items: [{imageUrl?, imageAlt?, heading, content}].

items.heading: Graphic heading
items.content: A short description of what this item represents.

items.heading: Graphic heading
items.content: A short description of what this item represents.

EmbedContainer.description: USWDS embed container — a responsive aspect-ratio wrapper for iframe embeds such as YouTube videos. ratio: 16x9 (default) or 4x3. Provide a descriptive title for accessibility.

Form.description: USWDS form container (usa-form). Applies USWDS form layout — constrained max-width and consistent label/input spacing — to nested form elements. large: wider form variant. Wrap Input, Select, Checkbox, Radio, and other form components as children.

Section.description: USWDS page section (usa-section). Applies consistent vertical padding to a full-width page section inside a grid-container. variant: default, light (lighter background), dark (darker background). title and text are optional — use children slots for richer content.
